title: 倫敦奧林匹克公園棕地整治~London Olympic Park brownfield remediation
focus: 棕地污染分流、土壤清洗與回用證據~Brownfield segregation, soil washing and reuse evidence
summary: 以倫敦奧運場址整治為參考，先建立土壤—地下水概念模型，再追蹤粒級、洗水、殘渣與合格回填批次。土地變綠不能代替污染物驗收。~Using the London Olympic site as a reference, build a soil-groundwater conceptual model and trace size fractions, washwater, residuals and accepted backfill. Green appearance does not replace contaminant acceptance.

units.title: 污染分區與乾土盤點：土壤污染質量與範圍~Contamination zoning and dry-soil inventory: Soil contaminant mass and extent
units.mechanism: 污染濃度乘乾土質量估計污染庫存；空間異質性與土壤體積密度會控制不確定度。本單元在「污染分區與乾土盤點」觀察此因果關係。~Concentration times dry-soil mass estimates contaminant inventory; spatial heterogeneity and bulk density govern uncertainty. Examine this relationship at contamination zoning and dry-soil inventory.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾土1000 t、代表性濃度200 mg/kg。公式 Mcontaminant=Msoil C/1000；代入 1000*200/1000 = 200 kg。適用邊界：代表性平均濃度假設，不能替代熱點與暴露途徑調查。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry soil1000 t and representative concentration200 mg/kg. Formula Mcontaminant=Msoil C/1000; substitution 1000*200/1000 = 200 kg. Boundary: Representative mean concentration assumed; hotspots and exposure pathways need separate investigation.
units.verify: 建立採樣網格與深度分層，查檢出限、重複樣及空白樣。在離線場景為「污染分區與乾土盤點」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Create a sampling grid and depth strata, checking detection limits, duplicates and blanks. Build an offline evidence table for contamination zoning and dry-soil inventory; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以乾淨區稀釋平均濃度會掩蓋局部熱點。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Diluting the mean with clean areas hides hotspots. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 全場平均濃度低就代表每一處都安全。~A low site mean proves every location is safe.
units.practice: 先點選「污染分區與乾土盤點」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把土壤量改成1500 t，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 300 kg。與基準 200 kg比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the contamination zoning and dry-soil inventory measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only soil mass to1500 t with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 300 kg. Compare with baseline 200 kg and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 洗土粒級分離：洗土分級與污染濃縮~Wash-plant fractionation: Soil washing and contaminant concentration
units.mechanism: 污染若偏附細粒，分級可使粗粒再利用而把污染集中到細泥；這是分離而非破壞。本單元在「洗土粒級分離」觀察此因果關係。~When contamination associates with fines, separation can recover coarse soil while concentrating contamination in sludge; this separates rather than destroys it. Examine this relationship at wash-plant fractionation.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：總污染100 kg、80%進入20 t乾細泥。公式 Cfines=Mcont f/(Mfines*1000)*1e6；代入 100*0.80/(20*1000)*1e6 = 4000 mg/kg。適用邊界：假想分配率；需確認溶出、水相與粗粒殘留才能封閉收支。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: total contaminant100 kg with80% entering20 t dry fines. Formula Cfines=Mcont f/(Mfines*1000)*1e6; substitution 100*0.80/(20*1000)*1e6 = 4000 mg/kg. Boundary: Hypothetical partition; dissolved mass and coarse residues must also close the balance.
units.verify: 秤各粒級並分析細泥、粗土與循環水，檢核三相去向。在離線場景為「洗土粒級分離」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Weigh size fractions and analyze fines, coarse soil and washwater to check all destinations. Build an offline evidence table for wash-plant fractionation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 只測粗土而漏細泥會誤報整治量與處置負擔。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Testing coarse soil alone misreports remediation and disposal burdens. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 洗土後粗粒變乾淨就代表污染元素消失。~Clean coarse soil after washing means the contaminant element disappeared.
units.practice: 先點選「洗土粒級分離」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把細泥質量改成25 t，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 3200 mg/kg。與基準 4000 mg/kg比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the wash-plant fractionation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only fines mass to25 t with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 3200 mg/kg. Compare with baseline 4000 mg/kg and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 洗水循環污染帳：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Recirculated-washwater pollutant ledger: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「洗水循環污染帳」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at recirculated-washwater pollutant ledger.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「洗水循環污染帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for recirculated-washwater pollutant ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「洗水循環污染帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the recirculated-washwater pollutant ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 細料與洗水固液分離：表面溢流率與沉降分離~Fines/washwater separation: Surface loading and settling separation
units.mechanism: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「細料與洗水固液分離」觀察此因果關係。~In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at fines/washwater separation.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
units.verify: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「細料與洗水固液分離」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for fines/washwater separation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要把池挖深就能任意增加沉澱流量。~Making a tank deeper permits unlimited settling flow.
units.practice: 先點選「細料與洗水固液分離」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把面積加至400 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15 m/d。與基準 20 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the fines/washwater separation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only area to400 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15 m/d. Compare with baseline 20 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 回填批次追溯：整治材料回用與獨立驗收~Accepted-backfill batch traceability: Remediated-material reuse and independent acceptance
units.mechanism: 回用比例只計入通過用途相符驗收的材料；處理過不代表所有粒級、所有污染物或所有用途均已合格。本單元在「回填批次追溯」觀察此因果關係。~Reuse fraction includes only material accepted for its intended use; treatment alone does not qualify every size fraction, contaminant or end use. Examine this relationship at accepted-backfill batch traceability.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：處理乾土1000 t、符合指定回用條件760 t。公式 r=100 maccepted/minput；代入 100*760/1000 = 76 %。適用邊界：教學驗收條件由題目假定，不代表任何司法管轄區標準；另查力學與浸出性質。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: treated dry soil1000 t and760 t meeting specified reuse acceptance. Formula r=100 maccepted/minput; substitution 100*760/1000 = 76 %. Boundary: Acceptance is hypothetical, not a jurisdictional standard; geotechnical and leaching properties need separate checks.
units.verify: 把每批採樣結果與回填位置綁定，保留不合格細料及出場聯單。在離線場景為「回填批次追溯」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Link each batch sample to its placement and retain rejected-fines and off-site transfer records. Build an offline evidence table for accepted-backfill batch traceability; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把待驗材料算入回用會高估成果；先隔離待驗批次再更新帳。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Counting material awaiting testing inflates reuse; separate pending batches before updating the ledger. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 回用比例越高就能證明殘餘風險越低。~A higher reuse fraction proves lower residual risk.
units.practice: 先點選「回填批次追溯」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把合格材料量改成680 t，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 68 %。與基準 76 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the accepted-backfill batch traceability measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only accepted material to680 t with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 68 %. Compare with baseline 76 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 地下水源—途徑—受體：補注與達西流~Groundwater source-pathway-receptor: Recharge and Darcy flow
units.mechanism: 飽和多孔介質中的達西通量取決於水力傳導係數與梯度；達西流速不是孔隙內水的速度。本單元在「地下水源—途徑—受體」觀察此因果關係。~Darcy flux in saturated porous media depends on hydraulic conductivity and gradient; it is not the pore-water velocity. Examine this relationship at groundwater source-pathway-receptor.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：K=5 m/d、梯度i=0.02、截面A=2000 m²。公式 Q=KiA；代入 5*0.02*2000 = 200 m³/d。適用邊界：均質飽和一維近似；不處理裂隙優勢流或非飽和區。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: K=5 m/d, gradienti=0.02 and cross-sectionA=2000 m². Formula Q=KiA; substitution 5*0.02*2000 = 200 m³/d. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated one-dimensional approximation; fractures and the unsaturated zone are excluded.
units.verify: 以觀測井水頭求梯度，分開估計K與有效孔隙率。在離線場景為「地下水源—途徑—受體」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use observation-well heads to estimate gradient and estimate K separately from effective porosity. Build an offline evidence table for groundwater source-pathway-receptor; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 細粒堵塞可降低K，即使水頭相同補注率仍會下降。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Fine-particle clogging can reduce K and recharge at the same head. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 達西流速與孔隙水流速必定相同。~Darcy flux always equals pore-water velocity.
units.practice: 先點選「地下水源—途徑—受體」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把K減成3 m/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 120 m³/d。與基準 200 m³/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the groundwater source-pathway-receptor measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only K to3 m/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 120 m³/d. Compare with baseline 200 m³/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 觀測井傳輸時間：地下水名目傳輸時間~Monitoring-well transport time: Nominal groundwater travel time
units.mechanism: 孔隙水速度約為Ki/ne；傳輸時間還受彌散、吸附及優勢流影響。本單元在「觀測井傳輸時間」觀察此因果關係。~Pore-water velocity is approximately Ki/ne; dispersion, sorption and preferential flow further influence travel. Examine this relationship at monitoring-well transport time.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：距離L=100 m、有效孔隙率ne=0.25、K=5 m/d、i=0.02。公式 t=Lne/(Ki)；代入 100*0.25/(5*0.02) = 250 d。適用邊界：均質平流示範，不是衛生防護距離或實際最短停留時間。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: distanceL=100 m, effective porosityne=0.25, K=5 m/d andi=0.02. Formula t=Lne/(Ki); substitution 100*0.25/(5*0.02) = 250 d. Boundary: Homogeneous advective example; not a sanitary setback or actual minimum residence time.
units.verify: 用保守示蹤與觀測井分布比較最早突破，不能只看平均。在離線場景為「觀測井傳輸時間」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare early breakthrough using a conservative tracer and monitoring wells, not only the mean. Build an offline evidence table for monitoring-well transport time; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 砂礫透鏡造成的快速通道會使平均模型過於樂觀。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A permeable gravel lens can make the mean model overoptimistic. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 平均傳輸時間保證所有污染物都有同樣衰減。~Mean travel time guarantees identical attenuation for all contaminants.
units.practice: 先點選「觀測井傳輸時間」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把梯度改成0.04，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 125 d。與基準 250 d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the monitoring-well transport time measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only gradient to0.04 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 125 d. Compare with baseline 250 d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 現地量測與實驗室校驗：感測器偏移校正~Field/laboratory cross-check: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「現地量測與實驗室校驗」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at field/laboratory cross-check.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「現地量測與實驗室校驗」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for field/laboratory cross-check; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「現地量測與實驗室校驗」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the field/laboratory cross-check measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 修復後植栽土層：生態廊道與可用棲地~Post-remediation planting soil: Ecological corridors and usable habitat
units.mechanism: 綠地面積與真正連通的可用棲地不同；硬質障礙、照明與維護方式影響動植物通行。本單元在「修復後植栽土層」觀察此因果關係。~Green area differs from connected usable habitat; hard barriers, lighting and maintenance affect movement. Examine this relationship at post-remediation planting soil.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：廊道長800 m、平均有效寬度12 m。公式 A=Lw；代入 800*12 = 9600 m²。適用邊界：幾何面積近似，不是物種存活率或生態服務價值。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: corridor length800 m and mean effective width12 m. Formula A=Lw; substitution 800*12 = 9600 m². Boundary: Geometric-area approximation, not survival probability or ecosystem-service valuation.
units.verify: 在地圖標斷點，搭配定點觀察確認指定物種是否實際使用。在離線場景為「修復後植栽土層」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Map breaks and use fixed observations to verify use by specified species. Build an offline evidence table for post-remediation planting soil; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 廊道被道路切斷時，相同面積仍可能失去連通。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A road break can destroy connectivity despite unchanged area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要綠地面積增加，所有物種都會受益。~More green area benefits every species.
units.practice: 先點選「修復後植栽土層」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效寬度減成8 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6400 m²。與基準 9600 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the post-remediation planting soil measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only effective width to8 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6400 m². Compare with baseline 9600 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 施工前後風險證據：前後與對照地點比較~Pre/post-construction risk evidence: Before-after and control comparison
units.mechanism: 干預前後差異還可能包含天氣與背景趨勢；前後—對照差分可分離共同變化但仍須檢查可比性。本單元在「施工前後風險證據」觀察此因果關係。~Before-after changes include weather and background trends; difference-in-differences removes common changes but still needs comparable sites. Examine this relationship at pre/post-construction risk evidence.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：處理地由30降至27，對照地由29降至28，同一指標。公式 effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore)；代入 (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit。適用邊界：假設共同背景趨勢；不是隨機試驗或完全因果證明。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: treated site30 to27 and control site29 to28 for the same indicator. Formula effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore); substitution (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit. Boundary: Common background trend assumed; not a randomized trial or complete causal proof.
units.verify: 採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「施工前後風險證據」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for pre/post-construction risk evidence; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 前後改變全都必定由這一項工程造成。~Every before-after change must be caused by this project.
units.practice: 先點選「施工前後風險證據」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把對照地事後值改成27，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 -1 indicator unit。與基準 -2 indicator unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the pre/post-construction risk evidence measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only control-after to27 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute -1 indicator unit. Compare with baseline -2 indicator unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

sources.title: 倫敦奧運場址土壤整治
sources.titleEn: Site remediation for the London Olympics

place.name: 倫敦奧林匹克公園代表點

history: 工程承包商DEME記錄倫敦奧運場址的土壤整治與材料回用；本課以EPA土壤清洗機理分析污染在細料及洗水間的轉移。~Contractor DEME documents soil remediation and material reuse at the London Olympic site; the lesson uses EPA soil-washing principles to analyze transfer into fines and washwater.

modelChecks.description: 單元1基準：污染分區與乾土盤點~Unit1 baseline: contamination zoning and dry-soil inventory
單元1變量實驗：只把土壤量改成1500 t~Unit1 changed-input experiment: change only soil mass to1500 t
單元2基準：洗土粒級分離~Unit2 baseline: wash-plant fractionation
單元2變量實驗：只把細泥質量改成25 t~Unit2 changed-input experiment: change only fines mass to25 t
單元3基準：洗水循環污染帳~Unit3 baseline: recirculated-washwater pollutant ledger
單元3變量實驗：只把流量改成1500 m³/d~Unit3 changed-input experiment: change only flow to1500 m³/d
單元4基準：細料與洗水固液分離~Unit4 baseline: fines/washwater separation
單元4變量實驗：只把面積加至400 m²~Unit4 changed-input experiment: increase only area to400 m²
單元5基準：回填批次追溯~Unit5 baseline: accepted-backfill batch traceability
單元5變量實驗：只把合格材料量改成680 t~Unit5 changed-input experiment: change only accepted material to680 t
單元6基準：地下水源—途徑—受體~Unit6 baseline: groundwater source-pathway-receptor
單元6變量實驗：只把K減成3 m/d~Unit6 changed-input experiment: reduce only K to3 m/d
單元7基準：觀測井傳輸時間~Unit7 baseline: monitoring-well transport time
單元7變量實驗：只把梯度改成0.04~Unit7 changed-input experiment: change only gradient to0.04
單元8基準：現地量測與實驗室校驗~Unit8 baseline: field/laboratory cross-check
單元8變量實驗：只把樣品原讀值改成16.2~Unit8 changed-input experiment: change only raw sample to16.2
單元9基準：修復後植栽土層~Unit9 baseline: post-remediation planting soil
單元9變量實驗：只把有效寬度減成8 m~Unit9 changed-input experiment: reduce only effective width to8 m
單元10基準：施工前後風險證據~Unit10 baseline: pre/post-construction risk evidence
單元10變量實驗：只把對照地事後值改成27~Unit10 changed-input experiment: change only control-after to27
